metadata.title: 成人现病史追问知识库（听障患者中英双语首版）

label.en: You or the room is spinning
Feel faint or about to pass out

label.zh: 突然出现，很快达到最重
label.en: Sudden and quickly at its worst

label.zh: 突然出现，但不是立刻最重
label.en: Sudden, but not immediately at its worst
Pressing the chest or moving the body
Skip and confirm privately with the doctor
Before or after a bowel movement
Standing up from sitting or lying
Unsteady but can walk without help
Sleepy or likely to doze off

label.zh: 某一侧或某个部位使不上力
label.en: Weakness in one side or body area

label.zh: 主要是喘，导致活动不了
大部分原来能做的事都做不了
label.en: Unable to do most previous activities

core_hpi_v1.description: 所有主症状共享的最小现病史属性

prompt.zh: 你现在还有这个不适吗？
prompt.en: Do you have this symptom right now?

prompt.zh: 这个不适最早什么时候开始？
prompt.en: When did this symptom first begin?

prompt.zh: 每次通常持续多久？如果一直存在，请选择“持续存在”。
prompt.en: How long does each episode usually last? Choose “continuous” if it does not stop.

prompt.zh: 这个不适出现得多频繁？
prompt.en: How often does this symptom happen?

prompt.zh: 最严重时有多难受？0 是完全不难受，10 是能想象的最难受。
prompt.en: At its worst, how bad is it? 0 means no discomfort and 10 means the worst you can imagine.

prompt.zh: 和刚开始相比，现在怎样？
prompt.en: Compared with when it began, how is it now?

prompt.zh: 这个不适对日常活动影响多大？
prompt.en: How much does this symptom affect your daily activities?

associated_followup_v1.description: 伴随症状选“有”后只展开一次，不再递归

prompt.zh: 它和主要不适在时间上是什么关系？
prompt.en: How is it timed in relation to the main symptom?

prompt.zh: 主要不适每次出现时，它也会一起出现吗？
prompt.en: Does it occur during the same episodes as the main symptom?

prompt.zh: 还有需要医生知道的简短说明吗？
prompt.en: Is there anything brief the doctor should know about it?

entry_prompts.en: Where in your chest do you feel discomfort?

prompt.zh: 不适主要在哪里？可以点选多处。
prompt.en: Where is the discomfort? You may choose more than one area.

prompt.zh: 这种感觉更像哪一种？
prompt.en: Which description best matches the feeling?

prompt.zh: 不适会扩散到其他地方吗？
prompt.en: Does the discomfort spread anywhere else?

prompt.zh: 开始时是突然达到最重，还是慢慢加重？
prompt.en: Did it become severe suddenly, or build up gradually?

prompt.zh: 什么情况下容易出现或加重？
prompt.en: What brings it on or makes it worse?

prompt.zh: 什么情况下会减轻？
prompt.en: What makes it better?

clinician_label.zh: 当前仍有重度胸部不适
clinician_label.en: Severe chest discomfort is present now

clinician_label.zh: 突发撕裂样胸部不适，可能向背部扩散
clinician_label.en: Sudden tearing chest discomfort, possibly spreading to the back

clinician_label.zh: 胸部不适伴晕倒或接近晕倒
clinician_label.en: Chest discomfort with fainting or near-fainting

clinician_label.zh: 胸部不适伴明显气短
clinician_label.en: Chest discomfort with marked shortness of breath

entry_prompts.zh: 胸闷更像胸口被压住、发紧，还是气不够？
entry_prompts.en: Does the chest tightness feel like pressure, squeezing, or not getting enough air?

prompt.zh: 胸闷最像哪一种感觉？
prompt.en: Which feeling best matches the chest tightness?

prompt.zh: 这种感觉主要在哪里？
prompt.en: Where do you mainly feel it?

prompt.zh: 开始时是突然出现，还是慢慢出现？
prompt.en: Did it begin suddenly or gradually?

prompt.zh: 什么情况下容易出现或加重？
prompt.en: What brings it on or makes it worse?

prompt.zh: 什么情况下会减轻？
prompt.en: What makes it better?

label.en: Chest pain at the same time

clinician_label.zh: 当前仍有重度胸闷
clinician_label.en: Severe chest tightness is present now

clinician_label.zh: 胸闷伴晕倒或接近晕倒
clinician_label.en: Chest tightness with fainting or near-fainting

clinician_label.zh: 胸闷伴明显气短
clinician_label.en: Chest tightness with marked shortness of breath

entry_prompts.zh: 你是在咳嗽，还是主要想清嗓子？
entry_prompts.en: Are you coughing, or mainly clearing your throat?

prompt.zh: 咳嗽时有痰吗？
prompt.en: Do you bring up phlegm when you cough?

prompt.zh: 痰是什么样？可以多选。
prompt.en: What is the phlegm like? Choose all that apply.

prompt.zh: 咳出的痰里有血或直接咳血吗？
prompt.en: Is there blood in the phlegm, or are you coughing up blood?

prompt.zh: 咳嗽什么时候更明显？
prompt.en: When is the cough more noticeable?

prompt.zh: 什么容易引起咳嗽？
prompt.en: What tends to trigger the cough?

prompt.zh: 最近是否接触烟雾、电子烟、粉尘、化学气味或工作环境刺激？
prompt.en: Have you recently been exposed to smoke, vaping, dust, chemical smells, or workplace irritants?

label.zh: 鼻塞、流涕、喉咙痒或声音变化
label.en: Blocked or runny nose, itchy throat, or voice change

label.zh: 体重明显下降或夜间出汗
label.en: Unexplained weight loss or night sweats

clinician_label.zh: 咳血或血痰
clinician_label.en: Coughing blood or blood-stained sputum

clinician_label.zh: 咳嗽伴明显气短
clinician_label.en: Cough with marked shortness of breath

clinician_label.zh: 持续咳嗽伴体重下降或夜间出汗
clinician_label.en: Persistent cough with weight loss or night sweats

entry_prompts.zh: 你量过体温，还是只是感觉发热？
entry_prompts.en: Did you measure your temperature, or do you only feel feverish?

prompt.zh: 你量过体温吗？
prompt.en: Did you measure your temperature?

prompt.zh: 最高体温是多少摄氏度？
prompt.en: What was the highest temperature in degrees Celsius?

prompt.zh: 体温是从哪里测的？
prompt.en: Where was the temperature measured?

prompt.zh: 发热是一直有，还是会退下去后又出现？
prompt.en: Is the fever continuous, or does it go away and return?

prompt.zh: 有没有冷得全身明显发抖、控制不住？
prompt.en: Have you had uncontrollable shaking chills?

prompt.zh: 近 3 个月去过外地或国外吗？
prompt.en: Have you travelled away from your area or abroad in the past 3 months?

prompt.zh: 最近身边有人也在发热或生病吗？
prompt.en: Has anyone around you recently had a fever or been ill?

prompt.zh: 你是否正在化疗，或使用会降低免疫力的药物？
prompt.en: Are you receiving chemotherapy or medicines that lower immunity?

label.en: Sore throat, blocked nose, or runny nose
Pain when urinating or pain in one side of the back

label.zh: 新出现皮疹、紫红点或皮肤颜色异常
label.en: New rash, purple-red spots, or unusual skin colour

label.zh: 反应变慢、意识不清或很难叫醒
label.en: Confusion, unusual drowsiness, or hard to wake

clinician_label.zh: 发热伴意识或反应异常
clinician_label.en: Fever with altered mental state

clinician_label.zh: 发热伴明显呼吸困难
clinician_label.en: Fever with marked breathing difficulty

clinician_label.zh: 发热伴紫红色或不褪色样皮疹
clinician_label.en: Fever with purple-red or non-blanching-type rash

clinician_label.zh: 发热伴黄疸
clinician_label.en: Fever with jaundice

clinician_label.zh: 发热且存在免疫抑制背景
clinician_label.en: Fever with an immunosuppression context

entry_prompts.zh: 请在腹部图上点出最痛的位置。
entry_prompts.en: Please tap the most painful area on the abdomen picture.

prompt.zh: 最痛的位置在哪里？可以点选多处。
prompt.en: Where does it hurt most? You may choose more than one area.

prompt.zh: 疼痛更像哪一种？
prompt.en: Which description best matches the pain?

prompt.zh: 疼痛是突然达到最重，还是慢慢加重？
prompt.en: Did the pain become severe suddenly, or build up gradually?

prompt.zh: 疼痛的位置后来移动过吗？
prompt.en: Has the pain moved from one area to another?

prompt.zh: 疼痛会扩散到背部、肩部、腹股沟或其他地方吗？
prompt.en: Does the pain spread to the back, shoulder, groin, or elsewhere?

prompt.zh: 什么会让疼痛出现或加重？
prompt.en: What brings on the pain or makes it worse?

prompt.zh: 什么会让疼痛减轻？
prompt.en: What makes the pain better?

prompt.zh: 如果你有怀孕可能：这次是否可能怀孕？你可以选择不回答并请医生单独确认。
prompt.en: If pregnancy is possible for you: could you be pregnant? You may skip and ask the doctor to confirm privately.

prompt.zh: 是否有非平常月经的阴道出血？你可以选择不回答。
prompt.en: Do you have vaginal bleeding that is not your usual period? You may skip this question.

label.en: Constipation, or unable to pass stool or gas
Vomiting blood, black stool, or blood in stool
Painful urination, frequent urination, or blood in urine

clinician_label.zh: 突发重度腹痛
clinician_label.en: Sudden severe abdominal pain

clinician_label.zh: 腹痛伴消化道出血表现
clinician_label.en: Abdominal pain with gastrointestinal bleeding

clinician_label.zh: 腹痛伴呕吐且停止排便排气
clinician_label.en: Abdominal pain with vomiting and inability to pass stool or gas

clinician_label.zh: 腹痛且可能妊娠，伴或不伴异常阴道出血
clinician_label.en: Abdominal pain with possible pregnancy, with or without unusual vaginal bleeding

clinician_label.zh: 腹痛伴晕倒或接近晕倒
clinician_label.en: Abdominal pain with fainting or near-fainting

terminology.note: HPO uses Dizziness as a synonym of Vertigo, while MeSH distinguishes them; preserve the patient's original wording.

entry_prompts.zh: 先告诉我们：头晕是一直存在，还是一阵一阵？
entry_prompts.en: First, is the dizziness continuous or does it come in episodes?

prompt.zh: 头晕是一直存在，还是一阵一阵？
prompt.en: Is the dizziness continuous or episodic?

prompt.zh: 每次头晕是否总由某个动作或情况引起？
prompt.en: Is each episode consistently triggered by a movement or situation?

prompt.zh: 头晕时更像哪一种感觉？这题只用于记录。
prompt.en: Which feeling best matches the dizziness? This is for description only.

prompt.zh: 头晕时你能自己站立和行走吗？
prompt.en: During the dizziness, can you stand and walk without help?

prompt.zh: 和你平时相比，听力是否新出现变化或明显变差？
prompt.en: Compared with your usual hearing, is there a new or clearly worse change?

prompt.zh: 是否新出现或明显加重耳鸣？
prompt.en: Is there new or clearly worse ringing in the ears?

label.zh: 新出现单侧无力/麻木、视物异常、说话或吞咽困难
label.en: New one-sided weakness or numbness, vision change, or difficulty speaking or swallowing

label.zh: 新出现剧烈头痛或颈部疼痛
label.en: New severe headache or neck pain
Chest pain, chest tightness, or irregular heartbeat

clinician_label.zh: 突发头晕伴局灶神经症状
clinician_label.en: Sudden dizziness with focal neurological symptoms

clinician_label.zh: 头晕时不能独立站立或行走
clinician_label.en: Unable to stand or walk independently during dizziness

clinician_label.zh: 头晕伴失去意识
clinician_label.en: Dizziness with loss of consciousness

clinician_label.zh: 头晕伴胸部不适或心律异常感觉
clinician_label.en: Dizziness with chest discomfort or irregular heartbeat

clinician_label.zh: 相对既有听力基线出现新的明显变化
clinician_label.en: New marked change from the person's usual hearing baseline

entry_prompts.zh: 你说的“累”更像没精力、想睡觉，还是肌肉使不上力？
entry_prompts.en: Does “tired” mean low energy, sleepiness, or muscles not working normally?

prompt.zh: 最主要是哪一种感觉？
prompt.en: Which feeling is the main problem?

prompt.zh: 和生病前相比，现在能做的事情减少了多少？
prompt.en: Compared with before this began, how much less can you do now?

prompt.zh: 一天中什么时候最明显？
prompt.en: When during the day is it most noticeable?

prompt.zh: 睡觉或休息后会怎样？
prompt.en: How do you feel after sleep or rest?

prompt.zh: 做完以前能承受的活动后，会不会明显更不舒服？
prompt.en: After an activity you used to tolerate, do you feel markedly worse?

prompt.zh: 如果活动后变差，通常多久恢复？
prompt.en: If activity makes you worse, how long does recovery usually take?

prompt.zh: 是否比以前更难集中注意、思考或记事？
prompt.en: Is it harder than before to concentrate, think, or remember?

prompt.zh: 站立或坐直一段时间后会更难受吗？
prompt.en: Do you feel worse after standing or sitting upright for a while?

label.zh: 发热、体重下降或夜间出汗
label.en: Fever, weight loss, or night sweats
Shortness of breath, chest pain, or chest tightness

label.zh: 异常出血、黑便或月经过多
label.en: Unusual bleeding, black stool, or very heavy periods

label.zh: 睡眠差、睡不解乏或白天很困
label.en: Poor sleep, unrefreshing sleep, or marked daytime sleepiness

label.zh: 持续心情低落或对事情失去兴趣
label.en: Persistent low mood or loss of interest

label.zh: 新出现身体一侧或某个部位明显无力
label.en: New marked weakness on one side or in one body area

clinician_label.zh: 乏力伴胸部不适或明显气短
clinician_label.en: Fatigue with chest discomfort or marked shortness of breath

clinician_label.zh: 乏力伴晕倒或接近晕倒
clinician_label.en: Fatigue with fainting or near-fainting

clinician_label.zh: 乏力伴活动性或明显出血线索
clinician_label.en: Fatigue with active or substantial bleeding symptoms

clinician_label.zh: 主诉乏力但存在新发局灶性无力
clinician_label.en: Reported fatigue with new focal weakness

clinician_label.zh: 功能较基线显著下降
clinician_label.en: Marked decline from baseline function
